<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אייר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918601_theRebbe_37" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_99_D7_99_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918601_theRebbe_37__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section contains the opening header and date of the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">Shabbat Parshat Emor,</t>
    <t s="2">the 19th of Iyar,</t>
    <t s="3">the year 5737*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the verse "Gal Einai" alludes to Lag BaOmer, and that one reaches the revelation of "Gal Einai" through the concept of "Ad HaGal HaZeh."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"Unveil my eyes and I will behold wonders from Your Torah"1,</t>
    <t s="1">and the Admore"r Maharash wrote in his maamar on this verse2,</t>
    <t s="2">that based on what is stated in the Siddur, Sha'ar HaLag BaOmer3,</t>
    <t s="3">that the hint in the Torah regarding Lag BaOmer is in the verse4</t>
    <t s="4">"Ad HaGal HaZeh" (Until this mound),</t>
    <t s="5">also the verse "Gal Einai" will be explained regarding Lag BaOmer.</t>
    <t s="6">And based on the known principle that all matters in the Torah are with utmost precision,</t>
    <t s="7">it must be said,</t>
    <t s="8">that this matter of Lag BaOmer in the verse "Gal Einai" etc. is learned from the matter of Lag BaOmer in the verse "Ad HaGal HaZeh",</t>
    <t s="9">it is,</t>
    <t s="10">that in order to come to the matter of "Gal Einai" etc., it is through "Ad HaGal HaZeh".</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the connection of this verse to Lag BaOmer, the day of Rashbi's passing, when the inner dimension of Torah was revealed and is reawakened each year.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">2)</t>
    <t s="1">Now, the connection of this verse to Lag BaOmer, the day of the passing of Rashbi</t>
    <t s="2">(simply),</t>
    <t s="3">is,</t>
    <t s="4">that the essence of Rashbi is – that through him was the revelation of the inner dimension of Torah</t>
    <t s="5">[and as explained in many places5,</t>
    <t s="6">that the revelation of the revealed Torah was through Moshe Rabbeinu and the revelation of the inner dimension of Torah was through Rashbi6],</t>
    <t s="7">and the primary revelation was on the day of his passing,</t>
    <t s="8">as it is brought in the Zohar7</t>
    <t s="9">that on the day of his passing he revealed to his students "sacred words" that he had not revealed during all the days of his life</t>
    <t s="10">(because the matters he revealed then were most sublime matters that even Rashbi was previously afraid to reveal8).</t>
    <t s="11">And through the writing of the sacred words</t>
    <t s="12">(according to his command9),</t>
    <t s="13">they were later revealed to all of Israel,</t>
    <t s="14">to the extent that they were revealed in a manner of "yitparnason"10,</t>
    <t s="15">in comprehension and perception.</t>
    <t s="16">That also the drawing down of this revelation</t>
    <t s="17">(the revelation to all of Israel and in a manner of "yitparnason")</t>
    <t s="18">was on the day of the passing of Rashbi</t>
    <t s="19">(through the writing of the sacred words then,</t>
    <t s="20">according to his command).</t>
    <t s="21">And to add,</t>
    <t s="22">based on the known principle11</t>
    <t s="23">that on the day of a person's passing, the inner dimension of all his service that he served throughout all the days of his life is revealed,</t>
    <t s="24">it is understood,</t>
    <t s="25">that on the day of the passing of Rashbi,</t>
    <t s="26">there was also revealed the inner dimension of the secrets that he revealed during all the days of his life.</t>
    <t s="27">And in every single year,</t>
    <t s="28">on the day of Lag BaOmer,</t>
    <t s="29">the revelation that was on Lag BaOmer the first time is reawakened12</t>
    <t s="30">– the revelation of the inner dimension of Torah</t>
    <t s="31">(the Torah of Rashbi).</t>
    <t s="32">And this is also understood from what is explained in many places13</t>
    <t s="33">that on Lag BaOmer is the giving of the Torah14</t>
    <t s="34">of the inner dimension of Torah,</t>
    <t s="35">similar to the holiday of Shavuot which is the time of the giving of the Torah in general.</t>
    <t s="36">From this it is understood,</t>
    <t s="37">that just as the giving of the Torah on Shavuot is in every single year,</t>
    <t s="38">so too the giving of the Torah of the inner dimension of Torah on Lag BaOmer is in every single year.</t>
    <t s="39">And this is that the matter of Lag BaOmer is hinted at in the verse "Gal Einai v'Avitah Nifla'ot miToratecha",</t>
    <t s="40">because "Nifla'ot" (wonders) in the Torah is the inner dimension of Torah15,</t>
    <t s="41">and the matter of "Gal" etc. "Nifla'ot" is the revelation</t>
    <t s="42">(Gal from the term Gilui [revelation]16)</t>
    <t s="43">of the wonders of the Torah</t>
    <t s="44">(the inner dimension of Torah)</t>
    <t s="45">that is drawn down in "GaL"</t>
    <t s="46">(on Lag BaOmer).</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
